scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy (for New and Existing Industries)
other_conditions: Investment must be made on or after 1 April 2017
Unit must provide at least 60% employment to residents of Puducherry
The 60% local employment must be maintained for the period specified in the affidavit
Fixed assets (plant and machinery) cannot be transferred or disposed of for 5 years from the date of application or disbursement, whichever is later
For partnership or private limited companies, all partners, shareholders and board members must belong to the same category (Women, SC, or ST)
For SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs, only investments in units fully owned by the respective category are eligible
Units established by the same proprietor with common partners or board are eligible as separate entities if they are located at different sites and have separate licences/clearances
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
Eligibility category noted in source: Large
Eligibility category noted in source: Women
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 45% on capital investments, with caps of ₹40 lakh for Micro/Small enterprises, ₹35 lakh for Medium/Large enterprises, and ₹75 lakh for Women/SC/ST entrepreneurs.
